svg.title: Cohort evidence synthesis and conservative SDRF refinement
svg.desc: Runs are grouped by acquisition features. Within a group, a shared tolerance is proposed from the maximum supported per-run estimate when coverage and unit gates pass, and recurrent mass-shift families must pass prevalence, identity, category and independent evidence gates. Accepted proposals are applied to the SDRF, validated and logged; uncertain evidence abstains or is held.

text.font-family: Arial, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, 'Liberation Sans', 'Nimbus Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif

svg.text: From per-run evidence to conservative SDRF proposals

text.font-family: Arial, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, 'Liberation Sans', 'Nimbus Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif

svg.text: Synthetic cohort. Per-run evidence is never study-wide truth: it must pass group-level gates, and every gate can abstain.

svg.text: Masses and candidate names are real catalogue look-ups; run counts are synthetic. Up to the 5 best-supported families per group are kept.

text.font-family: Arial, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, 'Liberation Sans', 'Nimbus Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif

svg.text: Hold and eligible families are both written to the putative column with their evidence fields (runs, prevalence, support, status); only eligible ones reach the standard column.
